compiled_state.title: Open deliberate-violation test PR on bootstrapped host project and verify security overlay blocks merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
On the bootstrapped host project from the preceding task, open a deliberate-violation test PR containing a known security issue, observe that the CI security overlay fires and blocks merge, then clean up all verification artifacts.

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make the E2E verification assertions pass once bootstrap task provides the host project.

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN the bootstrapped project from task 7e4e-2fee
  WHEN a test PR is opened with a deliberate security violation (e.g., hardcoded API key in a tracked file)
  THEN gh pr checks shows the llm-review CI job ran and exited non-zero
- GIVEN the CI job ran with security overlay enabled
  WHEN its logs are inspected
  THEN SECURITY_OVERLAY_TRIGGERED is present in the reviewer-findings output and ci-llm-review-runner.sh ran in fetched-assets mode (marker file confirms)
- GIVEN the CI job exits non-zero
  THEN gh pr merge --auto remains queued and does not execute (merge is blocked)
- GIVEN verification is complete
  THEN test PR is closed, test branch deleted, and $RUNNER_TEMP scratch is removed (cleanup verified)
- If any prerequisite from the bootstrap task was not met (explicit SKIP log present), this task also explicitly skips with a matching log (never silently passes)

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh (new test script)
- .test-index (add mapping: tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh [test_host_e2e_security_overlay_blocks_merge])

## Implementation Notes
- Deliberate violation: a file with the string `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-test-hardcoded-1234567890` in a tracked location
- Use `gh pr create --draft` to avoid inadvertent auto-merge triggers
- Poll `gh pr checks` with a timeout (max 10 minutes) for CI job completion
- Cleanup: `gh pr close`, `git push origin --delete <test-branch>`, `rm -rf $RUNNER_TEMP/<project-dir>`
- Load bootstrapped project path from the state file written by task 7e4e-2fee

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh exists and is executable. Verify: `test -x tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script derives the bootstrapped project path using the same logic as 7e4e (RUNNER_TEMP first, mktemp fallback). Verify: `grep -E 'RUNNER_TEMP|dso-host-e2e' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script asserts the project from 7e4e exists; if not, FAIL with a clear error. Verify: `grep -E 'bootstrap.*not found|project.*missing|run.*7e4e|bootstrap.*7e4e' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script creates a deliberate-violation file (hardcoded API key) on a new branch in the bootstrapped project. Verify: `grep -E 'sk-ant-test-hardcoded|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script opens a draft PR via gh pr create --draft. Verify: `grep -E 'gh pr create.*--draft' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script polls gh pr checks with a timeout of <=600 seconds for CI completion. Verify: `grep -E 'gh pr checks' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh && grep -E '600|10.*min|max.*time' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Test script asserts the llm-review CI job exited non-zero (security overlay blocked merge). Verify: `grep -E 'llm-review|security_overlay|reviewer-findings|exit.*non-?zero|FAIL' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Cleanup: closes test PR via gh pr close, deletes test branch, removes scratch directory. Verify: `grep -E 'gh pr close' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh && grep -E 'git push.*--delete|git branch -D' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh && grep -E 'rm -rf.*\$workdir|rm -rf.*RUNNER_TEMP' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] Prereq SKIP: if the bootstrap test was not run or its prereqs failed, this test FAILs explicitly (never silent skip). Verify: `grep -E 'prereq.*fail|bootstrap.*fail|missing' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh`
- [ ] .test-index has a RED marker entry: `tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh [test_host_e2e_security_overlay_blocks_merge]`. Verify: `grep -F 'tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh [test_host_e2e_security_overlay_blocks_merge]' .test-index`

## File Impact

- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh (NEW)
- .test-index (MODIFIED — add RED marker)
